original_prompt: Create a flowchart diagram showing the Google Apps Script visitor management system architecture
enhanced_prompt: A detailed flowchart showing the application architecture of a Google Apps Script visitor management system. The diagram should show: Google Sheets as data storage, Code.gs as backend API handling doGet/doPost, index.html as main visitor interface, admin.html as admin dashboard, app.js and admin.js as client-side JavaScript, and css/style.css for styling. Use clear arrows showing data flow between components. Modern, clean technical diagram style.
